freeze.statement: predictions.json and model.py are unchanged; every number below is a CHECK, an ARM or a post-data SCORE, as labelled.  The frozen numbers stay scoreable.

replica_check.what: this file's replica of the frozen calibration, run on the frozen inputs, against every kind's switching W (both arms) and ci95 upper edge in predictions.json; the file rounds to 3 dp

check_sign_term_on_price_list_rungs.reading: E65's bit_31 and E67's abit_31 are the only price-list rungs on which the PRODUCT's sign changes (B alternates +base/-base across the column halves against A = 1.0, so q = 1.000; A alternates by row against B = 1.0, so q = 0.500).  They cost 0.563 and 0.561 W; the frozen model, unchanged, says 8.70 and 4.61 W.  The premise that those lists never moved the product's sign is false, and the term is not a product-sign price.

check_e67_anchors_on_dumped_operands.what: E67's anchor_ones / anchor_pi / anchor_randn steps over anchor_zeros (E67 hl.json anchors p80), against the frozen model run on the tiles each kept pass dumped.  These are the SAME operand kinds as kinds.json fp32/ones, fp32/pi and fp32/randn, measured on E78's card and clock BEFORE the freeze.

e70_registered.A_form_verdict: REJECTED: the fitted asymptote lies below the ladder's own top rung and the residuals are systematic (S-shaped), so the saturating form does not describe the A side

check_law_on_e70_ladder.reading: every rung here is mantissa-only (q = 0), so the model's value is its bit term alone; with WB = 6.965 W that term can never exceed 6.96 W, and E70 measured lq_h23 at 12.145 W and ls_h16 at 9.749 W.  The law at the model's own W misses E70's 15-rung fit set by 1.236 W rms, not the 0.232 W every frozen interval borrows

check_randn_was_selected_on.reading: model.py says it fitted the overlap on randn in a first pass (-0.03) and then declared it zero; refitting reproduces lambda = -0.0288 with a residual of 0.  So randn chose the model's form and is not an out-of-sample check.  What survives: E70's one-sided steps over-add the split's flip term by 1.89 W (7.209 + 10.785 against 16.104), and the random-sign term fitted on `signs` takes up all but 0.15 W of that.

rows.label: selected-on (lambda fitted on the split and dropped)
by construction U + E70 nrd_a (only the card transfer is tested)
by construction U + E70 nrd_b (only the card transfer is tested)

check_e64_rows_relabelled.rel_band_note: REL_BAND fp32 = 12% was set with the out-of-sample residuals in view (model.py's own text: 'its own measured out-of-sample median miss is 6%, max 34%'), so it is not an independent error estimate

zero_products_unsigned.what: a zero product's sign is 0 (int8's two's-complement product; fp: no magnitude)

e70_actual_nrd_tiles.what: WA, WB calibrated on E70's DUMPED nrd_a / nrd_b tiles instead of the host stand-ins

e70_winf.what: WA, WB fixed at E70's own fitted 6.37 / 10.52 W; sigma re-fitted on `signs`

e71_slope.what: every aifoundry3 input at E71's measured 0.3803 W/C: E65/E67 prices x their own leak-sensitivity ratios, E70 nrd from its fixed-slope reductions, U from Q130(a)

interval_a1.rule: the frozen interval with ONE term replaced: E70's 0.232 W law rms becomes the law's rms at the model's own W on E70's ladder, 1.236 W per active B side (15-rung fit set) and 1.161 W per active A side (7 alq rungs), in quadrature, times the format's beta and the live fraction; a kind with no flips keeps the frozen term.  No A1 interval is narrower than its frozen one.

zero_products.definition: frozen: q counts sign(a) XOR sign(b) for every element, zero products included.  A1 arm: a product with a zero magnitude has sign 0, exactly an int8 product's two's-complement sign bit; alpha_fp16 / alpha_int8 and the bus arm re-calibrated under the same rule (fp32's calibration kinds hold no zeros, so WA, WB and sigma do not move)

score_r5_post_data.definition: alpha re-solved = E79's measured step for each rung over its own zero, divided by the model's LINEAR operand sum at alpha = 1 (model.price_lists: fp32's list by field role times r_T) on the SAME operands -- E79's dumped tiles run through model.features, so the model's own flip counting applies to both sides and no counting convention (E79's per-lane or per-unit int8 A footing) enters.  Reported as a ratio of sums over the whole list and over the significand, and at the top significand bit; the law's curvature is left out, as a per-bit price has none.  R5 asked for alpha in [0.5, 2.0] and never said which list, so every published list is scored

int8_b_kg.footing: kg (balanced accumulators, NOT E65's footing; a bound at E71's slope, E79 Result 4)

int8_b.footing: jg (does not alternate in int8, E79 A4)

score_u_post_data.what: E79's paired zeros - h0 step (no idle bracket, its amendment A7) measures exactly the model's U on E78's own card and clock: h16q / h8q are constant nonzero operands (no flips, no sign change).  It was public 5 min before the freeze.  Every constant kind (ones, neg_ones) is predicted at U.

gate_union.rule: gated = A word zero OR (fp32/fp16) B word zero / (int8) B pair (l, l+8) both zero: at independent element sparsity p about 2p - p^2 (fp32), 2p^2 - p^4 (fp16), p^4 + p^8 - p^12 (int8)

op_rate_gop_s.rule: E70's measured 1.1208 Gop/s at 546 cycles an op, times 546/318 for int8 (model.py line 661)

sign_bit_rank_e65.e65_registered: A3 FAIL: sign is rank 10 of 32 (the four cheapest are bits [6, 2, 5, 3])

excluded.fp32/pi: in sample (E70 anchor_pi is one of U's three levels)

flagged_not_blind.fp32/ones: E67 measured these operands (anchor_ones) on aifoundry3 at 600 MHz before the freeze; the model was not fitted on it (U uses lq_h0, aq_h0, anchor_pi)
